_comment: Read by START.command and START.sh before any PowerShell exists on the machine, which is why this file is flat enough for jq and separate from server.json. Neither macOS nor a stock Linux ships PowerShell, so those launchers provision a portable copy the same way they provision llama.cpp: download, verify the SHA-256, extract, never install. A pwsh already on PATH is used instead and nothing is downloaded.

linux._comment: Same contract as macOS, one entry per architecture. The x64 and arm64 tarballs are the portable builds: they need no glibc newer than what every current distro ships, and the only shared library they can be missing on a stripped-down image is libicu, which lib/bootstrap.sh names if the binary refuses to start.
